details: CVE-2026-39828 affects multiple packages. When an SSH server authentication callback returned PartialSuccessError with non-nil Permissions, those permissions were silently discarded, potentially dropping certificate restrictions such as force-command after a second factor succeeded. See references for individual vulnerability details.
